name: Breath Weapon Affinity (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Breath weapon, caster level 1st

Benefit(s): Three times per day as a free action your spells and spell like abilities that deal the same energy type damage as your breath weapon deal an additional 1d6 points of damage per spell level upon a failed save. If the spell has no save this a feat has no effect.
